people.name: Banikanta Kakati
people.field: Assamese language, literature, linguistics, cultural anthropology and comparative religion

relations.subject: Banikanta Kakati
relations.evidence: 1913, he stood first among all the candidates in the intermediate from Cotton College, Guwahati under the Calcutta University.

relations.subject: Banikanta Kakati
relations.evidence: He took first M.A. degree in English Literature from Presidency College, Calcutta in 1918.

relations.subject: Banikanta Kakati
relations.evidence: Later on he secured the first class first position in M.A. in English Language group in 1923 from Calcutta University.

relations.subject: Banikanta Kakati
relations.evidence: he obtained his doctorate for his thesis – Assamese : Its Formation and Development in 1935.

relations.subject: Banikanta Kakati
relations.evidence: Kakati joined Cotton College in 1918 as a professor of English until he became the principal of the college in 1947.
